description: auth.md claim. Pass your claim_token and the email of the shop owner who should claim you. You get a 6 digit user_code and a verification_uri: tell the person to open the link, sign in with that email and type the code. Then poll the token endpoint with grant_type urn:workos:agent-auth:grant-type:claim. Calling again with the same claim_token starts a fresh code and cancels the old one.
name: agents_claim

user_code.description: 6 digit code. Show it to the person; they type it on the claim page. Never put it in a URL.

verification_uri.description: Hosted claim page for the person to open.
